description: This PHP source file 'projectView.php' is part of the TestLink open source project. It handles displaying and managing test projects, including initializing page arguments, managing access to test projects based on user rights, and rendering templates with project data. It defines functions for argument initialization, GUI setup, and access management.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request arguments such as test project ID, action to perform, user ID, username, and test project name.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the graphical user interface data structure, including project list retrieval, user rights, and page configuration.

methods.name: initIntegrations
methods.description: Enhances project data with integration status icons based on project tracker configurations.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies if the user has the right to modify the product within the database context.
